standard_prerequisites.name: Scheme case: finite presentation over finite morphisms
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the schemes version applied to $\psi$.

core_obligations: Representability and chart: $f$ finite (hence representable); choose a scheme $V$ surjective \'etale over $Y$; $U = V \times_Y X$ is a scheme surjective \'etale over $X$ and $\psi : U \to V$ is finite (proof lines 765-771).
Transport: $\psi_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) = f_*\mathcal{F}|_V$, so finite presentation transfers both ways by the scheme case (proof lines 771-774).
proof_roadmap: Push the module identity through the chart and apply the scheme case.
difficulty_reason: Same chart pattern as its finite-type sibling: representability of the finite morphism, the \'etale chart $U = V \times_Y X$ finite over $V$, the identity $\psi_*(\mathcal{F}|_U) = f_*\mathcal{F}|_V$, and the scheme case conclude the finite-presentation equivalence.
